svg.title: Raw modal-transfer score does not define an admissible event
svg.desc: Nested uniform P1 FEM and independent conservative FD modal-transfer score over the frozen 1200-unit horizon. The S=0.5 crossing is diagnostic only because the predeclared 50-unit mode-one establishment condition failed; admissible event time is null.
